k_selection_reason: K=2 ranks first on the quantitative evidence score (silhouette 0.4340, mean ARI across the fixed seed set 0.998, smallest-cluster share 38.1%), but it falls below the documented minimum of 3 segments required for differentiated customer strategy: at that coarseness the partition reproduces only a broad active-versus-inactive split. The procedure therefore selects the top-ranked candidate with K >= 3: K=3 (evidence score 0.541, silhouette 0.3381, mean ARI 0.995, smallest cluster 17.2% of customers). The full evidence table for every candidate K, including K=2, is preserved in outputs/model_evaluation.csv and displayed on the Model Analysis page.
